name: Runway
summary: AI-powered video editor and generator with Gen-2 and text-to-video capabilities.
description:
AI-powered video editor and generator with Gen-2 and text-to-video capabilities.

AI Video Editing: Provides tools for background removal, color grading, and face blurring. Text-to-Video Generation: Generates videos from static images or text prompts using the Gen-3 Alpha model. Real-Time Collaboration: Allows multiple users to work simultaneously on a single project. Comprehensive Media Tools: Offers a suite of tools for generating and manipulating images, audio, and 3D assets.
